protocol: Observation only: all 15 all-other held-out takes plus 25 unique same-string/same-note controls; systematic full-take periodicity trajectories and independent harmonic spectra, no model fit or relabeling.

validation.focused_review: passed; no material blocker; octave ambiguity, correlated contexts and targeted-selection limits retained

bulk_policy: Retain per-window harmonic evidence remotely; collect small report and all compact trajectories once with server digest verification.
next: Commit the scoped source and worker files, dispatch once, collect the report and distinguish sustained non-octave disagreement, octave ambiguity and weak/variable source evidence. Preserve all original labels and scores.
limits: This is a targeted diagnostic subset selected after the earlier result, not an unbiased performance test or a new held-out score.
The short-window estimator is unchanged. Independent long-window spectra expose harmonic ambiguity; agreement does not prove the intended pitch or played string.
An even-harmonics-only lower note and an upper octave can have indistinguishable waveforms. Do not infer a corrected label from that case.

Spectral windows are centered retrospective observations; no causal or latency claim. Short takes use their full available length and report native frequency resolution. Zero padding only interpolates.
Overlapping windows are correlated. Counts describe this take, not independent examples or unique audio duration.
All selected takes, silent/unresolved windows and missing controls retained. No relabeling, exclusion, model fit, threshold sweep, score update or installed change.
Metadata neighbors are labeled pitches, not verified sounding notes; selected excerpts do not include the full original performance between takes.
